newsitem.title: USA: FORE has no comment on talks rumors.
newsitem.headline: FORE has no comment on talks rumors.

text.p: FORE Systems Inc on Friday declined comment on speculation that it was in talks with Cabletron Systems Inc or other potential suitors.
"We periodically are the subject of these kinds of rumors, but our policy is not to comment on them," FORE Chairman and Chief Executive Eric Cooper told Reuters.
Market rumors about merger talks drove FORE shares up 1-9/16 to 15-1/8. The stock was one of the most heavily traded issues on the Nasdaq.
Earlier, Cabletron denied it was in talks to buy FORE, but traders said there was still betting that FORE might be taken over by another suitor.
Cabletron shares were up 1-3/4 at 30-3/8 in mid-afternoon trade, despite the company's denial of talks with FORE.
Cabletron makes local area network (LAN) products. Pittsburgh-based FORE makes networking computer products based on asynchronous transfer mode (ATM) technology.
